lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਰਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੭੪॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer gur bhet mahaa sukh bhramat rahe man maanaanaa(n) ||4||23||74||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, meeting the Guru, I have found absolute peace. My mind has ceased its wanderings; I am happy. ||4||23||74||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਬਾਵਨ ਅਖਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee poorabee baavan akharee kabeer jeeu kee ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Baawan Akhree Of Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਨ ਅਛਰ ਲੋਕ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: baavan achhar lok trai sabh kachh in hee maahi ||
lines.translation: Through these fifty-two letters, the three worlds and all things are described.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਅਖਰ ਖਿਰਿ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਓਇ ਅਖਰ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: e akhar khir jaahige oi akhar in mahi naahi ||1||
lines.translation: These letters shall perish; they cannot describe the Imperishable Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਬੋਲ ਤਹ ਅਛਰ ਆਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jahaa bol tah achhar aavaa ||
lines.translation: Wherever there is speech, there are letters.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਅਬੋਲ ਤਹ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah abol tah man na rahaavaa ||
lines.translation: Where there is no speech, there, the mind rests on nothing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲ ਅਬੋਲ ਮਧਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bol abol madh hai soee ||
lines.translation: He is in both speech and silence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਸ ਓਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਸ ਲਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jas ohu hai tas lakhai na koee ||2||
lines.translation: No one can know Him as He is. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਹ ਲਹਉ ਤਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਕਹਉ ਤ ਕੋ ਉਪਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: alah lahau tau kiaa kahau kahau ta ko upakaar ||
lines.translation: If I come to know the Lord, what can I say; what good does it do to speak?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਟਕ ਬੀਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: batak beej mahi rav rahio jaa ko teen lok bisathaar ||3||
lines.translation: He is contained in the seed of the banyan-tree, and yet, His expanse spreads across the three worlds. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਹ ਲਹੰਤਾ ਭੇਦ ਛੈ ਕਛੁ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਭੇਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: alah laha(n)taa bhed chhai kachh kachh paaio bhed ||
lines.translation: One who knows the Lord understands His mystery, and bit by bit, the mystery disappears.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਲਟਿ ਭੇਦ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਭੰਗ ਅਛੇਦ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ulat bhed man bedhio paaio abha(n)g achhed ||4||
lines.translation: Turning away from the world, one's mind is pierced through with this mystery, and one obtains the Indestructible, Impenetrable Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਰਕ ਤਰੀਕਤਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: turak tareekat jaaneeai hi(n)doo bed puraan ||
lines.translation: The Muslim knows the Muslim way of life; the Hindu knows the Vedas and Puraanas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਨ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਕਛੂਅਕ ਪੜੀਐ ਗਿਆਨ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: man samajhaavan kaarane kachhooak paReeai giaan ||5||
lines.translation: To instruct their minds, people ought to study some sort of spiritual wisdom. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਆਦਿ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: oa(n)kaar aad mai jaanaa ||
lines.translation: I know only the One, the Universal Creator, the Primal Being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿ ਅਰੁ ਮੇਟੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: likh ar metai taahi na maanaa ||
lines.translation: I do not believe in anyone whom the Lord writes and erases.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: oa(n)kaar lakhai jau koee ||
lines.translation: If someone knows the One, the Universal Creator,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਲਖਿ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: soee lakh metanaa na hoee ||6||
lines.translation: he shall not perish, since he knows Him. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਕਾ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kakaa kiran kamal mahi paavaa ||
lines.translation: KAKKA: When the rays of Divine Light come into the heart-lotus,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਸਿ ਬਿਗਾਸ ਸੰਪਟ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sas bigaas sa(n)pat nahee aavaa ||
lines.translation: the moon-light of Maya cannot enter the basket of the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਰੁ ਜੇ ਤਹਾ ਕੁਸਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ar je tahaa kusam ras paavaa ||
lines.translation: And if one obtains the subtle fragrance of that spiritual flower,

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕਹ ਕਹਾ ਕਹਿ ਕਾ ਸਮਝਾਵਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: akah kahaa kahi kaa samajhaavaa ||7||
lines.translation: he cannot describe the indescribable; he could speak, but who would understand? ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਖਾ ਇਹੈ ਖੋੜਿ ਮਨ ਆਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: khakhaa ihai khoR man aavaa ||
lines.translation: KHAKHA: The mind has entered this cave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋੜੇ ਛਾਡਿ ਨ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: khoRe chhaad na dah dis dhaavaa ||
lines.translation: It does not leave this cave to wander in the ten directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮਹਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਖਿਮਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: khasamahi jaan khimaa kar rahai ||
lines.translation: Knowing their Lord and Master, people show compassion;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਖਿਅਉ ਅਖੈ ਪਦੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: tau hoi nikhiau akhai pad lahai ||8||
lines.translation: then, they become immortal, and attain the state of eternal dignity. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਗਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gagaa gur ke bachan pachhaanaa ||
lines.translation: GAGGA: One who understands the Guru's Word

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਧਰਈ ਕਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojee baat na dharaee kaanaa ||
lines.translation: does not listen to anything else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਬਿਹੰਗਮ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: rahai biha(n)gam katahi na jaaee ||
lines.translation: He remains like a hermit and does not go anywhere,

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਹ ਗਹੈ ਗਹਿ ਗਗਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: agah gahai gahi gagan rahaaee ||9||
lines.translation: when he grasps the Ungraspable Lord and dwells in the sky of the Tenth Gate. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਘਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਿਮਸੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghaghaa ghat ghat nimasai soee ||
lines.translation: GHAGHA: He dwells in each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat phoote ghat kabahi na hoee ||
lines.translation: Even when the body-pitcher bursts, he does not diminish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ਘਾਟ ਜਉ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa ghat maahi ghaat jau paavaa ||
lines.translation: When someone finds the Path to the Lord within his own heart,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਘਟੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਵਘਟ ਕਤ ਧਾਵਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: so ghat chhaad avaghat kat dhaavaa ||10||
lines.translation: why should he abandon that Path to follow some other path? ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਙੰਙਾ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਵਾਰੋ ਸੰਦੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: nga(n)ngaa nigrahi sanehu kar niravaaro sa(n)deh ||
lines.translation: NGANGA: Restrain yourself, love the Lord, and dismiss your doubts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਭਾਜੀਐ ਪਰਮ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਏਹ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naahee dekh na bhaajeeai param siaanap eh ||11||
lines.translation: Even if you do not see the Path, do not run away; this is the highest wisdom. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਚਾ ਰਚਿਤ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: chachaa rachit chitr hai bhaaree ||
lines.translation: CHACHA: He painted the great picture of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਚਿਤ੍ਰੈ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਚਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj chitrai chetahu chitakaaree ||
lines.translation: Forget this picture, and remember the Painter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਇਹੈ ਅਵਝੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chitr bachitr ihai avajheraa ||
lines.translation: This wondrous painting is now the problem.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਚਿਤ੍ਰੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਚਿਤੇਰਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: taj chitrai chit raakh chiteraa ||12||
lines.translation: Forget this picture and focus your consciousness on the Painter. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਛਾ ਇਹੈ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhachhaa ihai chhatrapat paasaa ||
lines.translation: CHHACHHA: The Sovereign Lord of the Universe is here with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਕਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਰਹਹੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhak k na rahahu chhaad k na aasaa ||
lines.translation: Why are you so unhappy? Why don't you abandon your desires?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਤਉ ਛਿਨ ਛਿਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man mai tau chhin chhin samajhaavaa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, each and every moment I try to instruct you,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਹਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਕਤ ਆਪੁ ਬਧਾਵਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: taahi chhaad kat aap badhaavaa ||13||
lines.translation: but you forsake Him, and entangle yourself with others. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਜਾ ਜਉ ਤਨ ਜੀਵਤ ਜਰਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jajaa jau tan jeevat jaraavai ||
lines.translation: JAJJA: If someone burns his body while he is still alive,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਬਨ ਜਾਰਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: joban jaar jugat so paavai ||
lines.translation: and burns away the desires of his youth, then he finds the right way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸ ਜਰਿ ਪਰ ਜਰਿ ਜਰਿ ਜਬ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: as jar par jar jar jab rahai ||
lines.translation: When he burns his desire for his own wealth, and that of others,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਜਾਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜਾਰਉ ਲਹੈ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: tab jaai jot ujaarau lahai ||14||
lines.translation: then he finds the Divine Light. ||14||
